notes: «قال أخبرني أبي» gives a bare father with no name: a relation link
«عن عائشة بنت طلحة، ومجاهد، عن عائشة»: two co-transmitters at one level; the Companion Aisha is the second «عائشة» in the text, occurrence 2 (the first is inside «عائشة بنت طلحة»)
the saying is the Prophet's, relayed by Aisha's own words: she is the last link
